meta.prompt_source: 英语二大作文（图表作文：某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比）

band.rationale: 对照第三档描述：'基本完成了试题规定的任务'，'应用的语法结构和词汇能满足任务的需求'，'有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解'，'采用简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰'。本篇覆盖图表三组数据（35%/45%/20%）并按题面要求给出评论，三段式层次清晰，但全文 10 句中约 7 句含语法或拼写错误，句式与词汇停留在基础层面，未达第四档'语言基本准确''使用较丰富的语法结构和词汇'的标准。字数 135/150（ratio 0.9，soft_ok）属小幅不足，按扣分锚点第 3 条不机械罚分，仅在批改中提示。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三组数据全部覆盖、未跑题，评论部分也切题；但描述仅为逐项罗列，缺少一句对整体分布特征的概括（如多数学生参与频率低），图表'解读'停留在表面，未满 5 分。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: some students think study is more important than volunteer work
dimensions.deduction_reason: 给出两个原因和一条建议，方向相关；但每个原因仅一个分句带过、未做任何展开，评论部分 It can help us learn skill and make friend 较笼统，缺具体收益或例证，'未能有效阐述内容要点'。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 描述—原因—评论三段式清晰，Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 衔接得当但手法单一；第二段第二个原因与前句仅以逗号粘连相连，衔接粗糙，扣 0.5。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: volunteer activities is good for students. It can help us learn skill and make friend.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 10 句中 7 句含错误：主谓一致两处（activities is；does not provides）、可数名词单复数（skill、friend）、逗号粘连、相邻重复词 the the（预检已标记）、phenomonon 拼写；句式全程为简单句与并列句，几乎每段都有错误，按锚点重扣至 0.5。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.deduction_reason: percentage 误用贯穿数据描述共 3 处；速查表中式直译命中两处（the situation of...taking part in；grow up better）；话题词汇（volunteer activities、balance、offer more chances）基本达意，给 1 分。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段式齐整、分段合理，无格式与卷面问题，满分保留。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: the situation of ... taking part in 属中式直译（速查表 5.1 命中，按表定级为 awkward），语法成立但含混，未点出图表实际内容即参加频率的分布。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities every month.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 是名词，不能直接跟在数词后表示'百分之'，应用 percent；take part in one to two times 中 in 缺少宾语，搭配不完整。
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of the students never take part in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them take part once or twice every month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 同样误用 percentage，且缺少介词 of，20 percentage students 结构不成立。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students join in three times or more every month.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写错误，正确拼写为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: 助动词 does 后应接动词原形 provide；两个独立分句仅用逗号连接构成逗号粘连，应加连词或改用分号。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to join in.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主语 volunteer activities 为复数，谓语应用 are，主谓不一致。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: skill 和 friend 为可数名词，此处应用复数 skills、friends；且 It 指代上句复数的 activities，宜改为 They。
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: the the 为相邻重复用词（预检脚本已标记）；balance the study 中冠词多余，balance 后应直接接并列宾语。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more chances, and students should balance study and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: grow up better 属'更好地成长'的中式直译（速查表 5.1 命中，按表定级为 awkward），语义含混；句首 Only 引起的倒装结构使用正确，值得保留。
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we make greater progress.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities every month. 35 percent of the students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percent take part once or twice a month. In other words, only a small share of students volunteer on a regular basis.

There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to join in.

In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students, because they help us learn skills, make friends and better understand society. Therefore, the school should offer more chances and promote volunteer programs on campus, while students should learn to balance study and volunteer work. Only in this way can we make greater progress.
top_problems: percent/percentage 误用贯穿全部数据描述（3 处），直接削弱图表作文最核心的数据呈现能力
基础语法错误几乎每段都有：主谓一致（activities is；does not provides）、可数名词单复数（skill、friend）、逗号粘连、the the 相邻重复
内容展开过薄：两个原因与评论各一句带过，且描述段缺少对整体分布特征的概括句
practice_advice: 本周专项训练数据描述句型：每天仿写 3 个 'X percent of + the + 名词 + 谓语' 句子并大声朗读检查；每写完一句，对每个可数名词自问 one or more，对每个谓语回找主语核对单复数，用这套两步自查消灭本篇的高频错误。

patterns: There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
In my opinion, ... are good for ..., because ...
Only in this way can we ...
